notes.title: Big content update!
notes.notes:
The large content update is now available!

This will be the last major update for Early Access.

For patch notes, please see the following forum post:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2027560/discussions/0/3648503910213542054/ 

Thank you!

notes.title: Added "Pet" as equipment!
notes.notes:
A pet can now be purchased and added to your equipment!

There is currently only 1 pet available, although more will be rolled out with more content. This one took quite a bit of work to add, sorry for the slow update - but it's finally here!

Valkyries can now have a full set of equipment and become a fighting force :) With this out of the way, hopefully we can start rolling out more missions and equipment :)

notes.title: Area of Effect spells added!
notes.notes:
The Valkyrie's special attacks have been changed up a bit, some of them now having "Area of Effect" floor symbols that can deal damage over time as enemies step into them!

These spells place a magic circle on the ground which can have various effects. Currently they are kept simple as a lot of groundwork went into making them functional. As more content rolls out, these spells will become more varied!

notes.title: Character skins and power attacks!
notes.notes:
- 2 character skins each Valkyrie
- Skins offer an additional powerful attack that can be manually used like a "special power"
- Moved Boss HP bars to prevent overlapping UI
- Fixed EXP Bug
- Increased amount of EXP needed to level up

Please note that the special attacks may be swapped out for different attacks at a future date, we are still working on improving the attack types.

notes.title: Some tweaks
notes.notes:
- Reworked the way shop works in preparation for more content
- Items require you purchase the item before it before unlocking, to prevent cheesing through skipping items
- Added cooldown timer icons to the HUD during missions in preparation for more content and to better time certain attacks

notes.title: Small fix
notes.notes:
- Boss HP Bars fixed when multiple bosses per mission
- Simplified Chinese language missing icons fixed

notes.title: Valkyrie Champions now available!
notes.notes:
[h2]Valkyrie Champions has now been releasing into Steam Early Access![/h2]

View the launch patch notes here:

[h3]v 0.007 (Early Access Launch)[/h3]
------------

- All Beta game save data removed
- Gold and EXP Items vacuum towards you on Victory
- Complete overhaul of damage formula to allow for better progression
- EXP re-balanced
- Multiplayer EXP desync bug fixed (hopefully)
- Medal times tweaked
- Password Protected Lobbies
- ZQSD support for Azerty keyboards
- First phase in every mission has reduced Enemy HP to help get player started on the mission
- Revive recovers all HP instead of half
- Revive time reduced from 15 seconds to 12 seconds
- AI Variations for some bosses
- Small AI Variations for some monsters
- Health item drop quantity nerfed
- Pausing at end of mission softlock fix
- Artwork added for 4th Valkyrie
- Items no longer spawn on-top of level boundaries
- "MP" text changed to "Power"
- Hungarian Localization improved

notes.title: Major multiplayer bug fix! Yay!
notes.notes:
There was quite an annoying bug with 2+ player co-op where one or more of the players wouldn't receive rewards for missions. 

This has now been fixed!

There has also been an adjustment for Character Endurance stat

Thank you!
